<ic>The Quartermaster General makes the announcement that he intends to use his power of Emergency Resupply:

* 50 Wains to the Bounders
* 50 Wains to the Citadel Guard
* 2 Wains to the Wolves of War</ic>

===Overview===
* Resupply [[the Marches|Marcher]] army of the [[The Marches military concerns#Bounders|Bounders]] with 50 wains.
* Resupply the [[Urizen]] army of [[Urizen_military_concerns#The army of the Citadel|Citadel Guard]] with 50 wains.
* Resupply [[the League]] army of [[The League military concerns#The Wolves of War|Wolves of War]] with 2 wains.
* This motion was approved by the Quartermaster General using the legal power to resupply armies granted by the [[Senate]].
* This motion would be subject to the [[Synod]] [[veto]].

===Date===
* Spring Equinox 379YE

===Progress===
* 80 wains of weirwood and wains of 22 mithril provided by Irontide Rad, Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies, after Spring Equinox 379YE 

===Campaign Outcome===
* [[Casualties#Emergency_Resupply|Resupply]] an army using 50 wains restores fighting strength equal to 1000 soldiers to the army.
* Resupply an army using 2 wains restores fighting strength equal to 40 soldiers to the army.
